create_Move_task: create a Move task to move the robot agent to an absolute or relative target coordinate
create_Get_task: create a Get task to pick up an object and optionally drop it at a target location
create_CuriousExplore_task: create a CuriousExplore task to explore the environment using SLAM and examine detected objects
create_Look_task: create a Look task to orient the robot camera at a target or set yaw and pitch angles
create_Reexplore_task: create a Reexplore task to run multiple examination strategies including straightline, circle, and random exploration
